title: Prevent binary proof PNG corruption instead of only detecting it
goal:
# Prevent binary proof PNG corruption instead of only detecting it

## Context
Case study: KainBain task 68714709-3f50-4e5c-bfa6-bac16a36c393 (docs viewer sidebar). Ticket b1c069e0 (completed) added detection: a proof-hygiene CI check rejecting PNGs with wrong magic bytes. Detection works, but prevention does not: the same three proof PNGs (docs-sidebar-collapsed/expanded/filtered-proof.png) were corrupted twice on this ticket by agents rewriting binaries through text-oriented tools (magic efbfbd instead of 89504e47), failing full CI twice (automated-tests-failure-20261115-195001.md and automated-tests-failure-20261115-205407.md, ~1000s burned per cycle plus fallback routing), and a docs-only stage had to restore them via git checkout HEAD (review-pr-20261116.md section 7). Each recurrence costs a full verification cycle even though the committed fix was already correct.

## Steps
1. Make screenshot/proof capture write PNGs directly to the task docs folder without agent text-tool handling (e.g. capture script writes the file itself; agents only reference the path), so there is no text-path rewrite step to get wrong.
2. Document a binary-safe rule where agents look it up: never create, edit, or restore *.png (or other binaries) with text edit/write tools; verify with magic bytes (xxd/file) before claiming validity.
3. Optionally block text-tool writes of binary extensions at the tooling or pre-commit level so the mistake fails fast locally instead of after a 15+ minute CI run.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An agent following the documented path can attach proof PNGs without ever passing bytes through a text tool.
- [ ] A text-path rewrite of a PNG is either impossible or fails fast locally with a message naming the file.
- [ ] Valid PNG proofs still pass the existing proof-hygiene check unchanged.

## Notes
Structural follow-on from task 68714709-3f50-4e5c-bfa6-bac16a36c393; detection ticket b1c069e0 stays as is, this ticket covers the prevention gap its own history exposes. No open ticket in stage 1 covers this (checked before creating).

1|# Implementation Plan — Prevent binary proof PNG corruption (prevention follow-on to b1c069e0)
2|
3|## Goal
4|
5|Stop proof-PNG corruption at the source instead of catching it in CI 15+ minutes later. An agent following the documented path must be able to attach proof PNGs without bytes ever passing through a text tool, a text-path rewrite must fail fast locally naming the file and the safe alternative, and valid PNG proofs must keep passing the existing proof-hygiene gate unchanged (detection ticket b1c069e0 stays as is).
6|
7|## Success Criteria
8|
9|- [ ] An agent following the documented path can attach proof PNGs without ever passing bytes through a text tool.
10|- [ ] A text-path rewrite of a PNG is either impossible or fails fast locally with a message naming the file.
11|- [ ] Valid PNG proofs still pass the existing proof-hygiene check unchanged (`npm run check:proof-hygiene` green, no changes to its pass/fail semantics for valid files).
12|
13|## Context and Starting Facts (researched 2026-11-16, no code changed)
14|
15|- **Detection already exists and stays untouched:** `scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs` (magic-byte validation for proof images + root-scratch rules, dependency-free, baseline-aware) is wired as the `Proof Hygiene` branch in `scripts/run-tests.mjs` (~line 472) and reachable via `npm run check:proof-hygiene`. Unit/pinning coverage lives in `tests/check-proof-and-hygiene.test.mjs`. Any prevention work must not weaken this gate.
16|- **Direct-write capture already exists and is the prevention primitive:** `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs` writes bytes directly via Playwright (`page.screenshot({ path })`), accepts `--url` / `--path` / `--out` / `--click` / `--width` / `--height` / `--wait`, creates the output directory itself, and already carries the binary-safe proof checklist in its header comment. The plan builds on it rather than inventing a second capture path.
17|- **The documented rule already exists in one place:** `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` ("Binary-safe proof artifacts") + pointer from `agents.md` line 13. It states the never-through-text-tools rule, the two safe paths (capture script, `git checkout <ref> -- <path>`), and the `xxd`/`file` verification quoting requirement. Per survey answer Q2 this must now live in **both** places, not just here.
18|- **No local fail-fast exists:** no `.husky/` hook, no `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, no staged-binary guard was found. Step 3 of the ticket is therefore greenfield and is the highest-risk decision (see Key Decisions).
19|- **Corruption signature is known:** magic `ef bf bd` (UTF-8 replacement character from a text round-trip) instead of PNG `89 50 4e 47`, `file` reporting `data`. Both the detector message and the future guard message should name this signature so agents recognise it.
20|
21|## Key Decisions (driven by SURVEY.md grill answers)
22|
23|| Survey Q | Answer given | Plan consequence |
24||---|---|---|
25|| Q1 safe attach path | Both: automatic tool plus short guide | Keep `capture-screenshot.mjs` as the tool; add a 5-line agent-facing recipe. Neither alone. |
26|| Q2 rule location | Both: main helper guide + note near proof folder | Update `GitGuidance.md` **and** add a short note at/near the proof-pictures location (exact filename decided in Phase 0; candidate: `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md` or a per-task-folder stub). |
27|| Q3 wrong-way behaviour | Stop it and explain the safe way | The guard must exit non-zero, name the file, show expected-vs-actual magic, and print the exact safe command. A warning-only mode is rejected. |
28|| Q4 file coverage | PNG + all pictures + all non-text, extendable | Drive the guard from the existing `MAGIC_TABLE` extension set plus a small configurable binary-extension list (`png jpg jpeg gif webp`, open to `zip/tgz`), so future taggable types (survey note) slot in without redesign. |
29|| Q5 old damage | Also repair old broken pictures if found | Include a bounded repair sweep: enumerate current magic failures, restore each from a known-good ref (`git checkout <ref> -- <path>`), re-verify with `xxd`/`file`; record unrestorable ones in the existing baseline file rather than silently deleting. |
30|| Notes (tagged photos) | Photos live in the task directory and are referenced | Capture `--out` defaults/examples must point into the task docs folder (`docs/tasks/<task-id>/`), and the guide shows reference-not-copy attachment. UI tagging mechanics are out of scope. |
31|
32|## Approach — Make the Change Easy, Then Make the Change
33|
34|Order deliberately puts research and the highest-uncertainty piece (the fail-fast guard mechanism) first, shrinks the change surface by reusing the two assets that already work (capture script, detector), and leaves docs + repair + verification to the end when the mechanism is settled. No new abstraction is introduced: one guard, one recipe, one second doc location.
35|
36|## Steps
37|
38|### Phase 0 — Grounding inventory (make the change easy, part 1)
39|
40|1. Confirm the reuse surface with targeted reads only (no edits): `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs` flags, `scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs` `MAGIC_TABLE` / `isProofPath` / `formatFailure`, `scripts/run-tests.mjs` Proof Hygiene branch, `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` binary-safe section, `tests/check-proof-and-hygiene.test.mjs` fixture pattern.
41|2. Decide the exact second doc location from Q2: check whether proof folders share one parent that can hold a single note vs. needing a per-task stub; record the chosen path in the plan before writing it.
42|3. Decide the guard mechanism (the plan's one research spike — this step). Candidates: (a) lightweight pre-commit hook or `lint-staged`-style staged-file check reusing `checkFileMagic`; (b) a small wrapper/preflight script agents run before commit (`npm run check:proof-local` or similar); (c) harness-level interception of text-tool writes by extension. Evaluate against: works offline, runs in <5s, names the file + safe remedy, zero new runtime dependencies, extendable extension list. Recommend (a)+(b) sharing one checker module; treat (c) as stretch only if the harness exposes a clean interception point.
43|4. Enumerate current damage: run `npm run check:proof-hygiene` and `node scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs --strict` on a clean checkout; list every failing path (expect the three `docs-sidebar-*proof.png` files from the ticket history if still corrupt) and identify a known-good ref per file for the step 9 repair.
44|
45|### Phase 1 — Smallest safe-path recipe (make the change easy, part 2)
46|
47|5. Write the 5-line agent recipe (canonical form, exact flags verified against the script in Phase 0): capture with `node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --path … --out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png`, then verify with `xxd -l 8 <path>` (expect `8950 4e47…`) and `file <path>` (expect `PNG image data`), then run the local gate. Keep it copy-pasteable; no prose alternative that invites improvisation.
48|6. Confirm the recipe end-to-end once against a disposable output path (headless, existing mock fixture or `npm run capture:screenshot` pattern per Testing Guidance — no long-lived server): prove the script writes valid magic without any agent text-tool step, then delete the disposable file or move it out of `docs/`.
49|
50|### Phase 2 — The prevention change

11|- [ ] Valid PNG proofs still pass the existing proof-hygiene check unchanged (`npm run check:proof-hygiene` green, no changes to its pass/fail semantics for valid files).
12|
13|## Context and Starting Facts (researched 2026-11-16, no code changed)
14|
15|- **Detection already exists and stays untouched:** `scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs` (magic-byte validation for proof images + root-scratch rules, dependency-free, baseline-aware) is wired as the `Proof Hygiene` branch in `scripts/run-tests.mjs` (~line 472) and reachable via `npm run check:proof-hygiene`. Unit/pinning coverage lives in `tests/check-proof-and-hygiene.test.mjs`. Any prevention work must not weaken this gate.
16|- **Direct-write capture already exists and is the prevention primitive:** `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs` writes bytes directly via Playwright (`page.screenshot({ path })`), accepts `--url` / `--path` / `--out` / `--click` / `--width` / `--height` / `--wait`, creates the output directory itself, and already carries the binary-safe proof checklist in its header comment. The plan builds on it rather than inventing a second capture path.
17|- **The documented rule already exists in one place:** `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` ("Binary-safe proof artifacts") + pointer from `agents.md` line 13. It states the never-through-text-tools rule, the two safe paths (capture script, `git checkout <ref> -- <path>`), and the `xxd`/`file` verification quoting requirement. Per survey answer Q2 this must now live in **both** places, not just here.
18|- **No local fail-fast exists:** no `.husky/` hook, no `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, no staged-binary guard was found. Step 3 of the ticket is therefore greenfield and is the highest-risk decision (see Key Decisions).
19|- **Corruption signature is known:** magic `ef bf bd` (UTF-8 replacement character from a text round-trip) instead of PNG `89 50 4e 47`, `file` reporting `data`. Both the detector message and the future guard message should name this signature so agents recognise it.
20|
21|## Key Decisions (driven by SURVEY.md grill answers)
22|
23|| Survey Q | Answer given | Plan consequence |
24||---|---|---|
25|| Q1 safe attach path | Both: automatic tool plus short guide | Keep `capture-screenshot.mjs` as the tool; add a 5-line agent-facing recipe. Neither alone. |
26|| Q2 rule location | Both: main helper guide + note near proof folder | Update `GitGuidance.md` **and** add a short note at/near the proof-pictures location (exact filename decided in Phase 0; candidate: `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md` or a per-task-folder stub). |
27|| Q3 wrong-way behaviour | Stop it and explain the safe way | The guard must exit non-zero, name the file, show expected-vs-actual magic, and print the exact safe command. A warning-only mode is rejected. |
28|| Q4 file coverage | PNG + all pictures + all non-text, extendable | Drive the guard from the existing `MAGIC_TABLE` extension set plus a small configurable binary-extension list (`png jpg jpeg gif webp`, open to `zip/tgz`), so future taggable types (survey note) slot in without redesign. |
29|| Q5 old damage | Also repair old broken pictures if found | Include a bounded repair sweep: enumerate current magic failures, restore each from a known-good ref (`git checkout <ref> -- <path>`), re-verify with `xxd`/`file`; record unrestorable ones in the existing baseline file rather than silently deleting. |
30|| Notes (tagged photos) | Photos live in the task directory and are referenced | Capture `--out` defaults/examples must point into the task docs folder (`docs/tasks/<task-id>/`), and the guide shows reference-not-copy attachment. UI tagging mechanics are out of scope. |
31|
32|## Approach — Make the Change Easy, Then Make the Change
33|
34|Order deliberately puts research and the highest-uncertainty piece (the fail-fast guard mechanism) first, shrinks the change surface by reusing the two assets that already work (capture script, detector), and leaves docs + repair + verification to the end when the mechanism is settled. No new abstraction is introduced: one guard, one recipe, one second doc location.
35|
36|## Steps
37|
38|### Phase 0 — Grounding inventory (make the change easy, part 1)
39|
40|1. Confirm the reuse surface with targeted reads only (no edits): `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs` flags, `scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs` `MAGIC_TABLE` / `isProofPath` / `formatFailure`, `scripts/run-tests.mjs` Proof Hygiene branch, `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` binary-safe section, `tests/check-proof-and-hygiene.test.mjs` fixture pattern.
41|2. Decide the exact second doc location from Q2: check whether proof folders share one parent that can hold a single note vs. needing a per-task stub; record the chosen path in the plan before writing it.
42|3. Decide the guard mechanism (the plan's one research spike — this step). Candidates: (a) lightweight pre-commit hook or `lint-staged`-style staged-file check reusing `checkFileMagic`; (b) a small wrapper/preflight script agents run before commit (`npm run check:proof-local` or similar); (c) harness-level interception of text-tool writes by extension. Evaluate against: works offline, runs in <5s, names the file + safe remedy, zero new runtime dependencies, extendable extension list. Recommend (a)+(b) sharing one checker module; treat (c) as stretch only if the harness exposes a clean interception point.
43|4. Enumerate current damage: run `npm run check:proof-hygiene` and `node scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs --strict` on a clean checkout; list every failing path (expect the three `docs-sidebar-*proof.png` files from the ticket history if still corrupt) and identify a known-good ref per file for the step 9 repair.
44|
45|### Phase 1 — Smallest safe-path recipe (make the change easy, part 2)
46|
47|5. Write the 5-line agent recipe (canonical form, exact flags verified against the script in Phase 0): capture with `node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --path … --out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png`, then verify with `xxd -l 8 <path>` (expect `8950 4e47…`) and `file <path>` (expect `PNG image data`), then run the local gate. Keep it copy-pasteable; no prose alternative that invites improvisation.
48|6. Confirm the recipe end-to-end once against a disposable output path (headless, existing mock fixture or `npm run capture:screenshot` pattern per Testing Guidance — no long-lived server): prove the script writes valid magic without any agent text-tool step, then delete the disposable file or move it out of `docs/`.
49|
50|### Phase 2 — The prevention change
51|
52|7. Implement the fail-fast guard from the Phase 0 decision: any write path that would route binary-extension bytes through text handling fails locally before commit/push, exit non-zero, message names the exact file, shows expected vs. actual magic where bytes exist, and prints the safe-path command from the recipe. Extension list is data (extends `MAGIC_TABLE` keys), not code branches, per Q4-extendability.
53|8. Place the binary-safe rule in both locations from Q2: (a) tighten the existing `GitGuidance.md` section to point at the recipe + guard (no duplication of the recipe body — link it); (b) add the short near-folder note chosen in step 2 containing the never-with-text-tools rule, the recipe, and the verify commands. Both must state: never create, edit, or restore `*.png` (and listed binaries) with text edit/write tools; verify with magic bytes before claiming validity.
54|9. Repair sweep (Q5): for each file listed in step 4, restore via `git checkout <good-ref> -- <path>`, re-verify `xxd` + `file`, and confirm the detector passes. Anything with no valid source goes into `scripts/baselines/proof-hygiene-known-violations.json` following the file's existing same-path-same-bytes convention — never silent deletion.
55|
56|### Phase 3 — Assurance (testing + documentation plans)
57|
58|10. Testing plan (execute in this order):
59|    - a. Regression: `npm run check:proof-hygiene` and the `tests/check-proof-and-hygiene.test.mjs` suite pass unchanged on valid proofs (acceptance criterion 3).
60|    - b. Guard unit tests: new fixture tests mirroring the existing fixture style — corrupt-magic PNG is rejected with the filename in the message; valid PNG passes; unknown extensions are skipped not failed; vanished-file and unreadable-file semantics match the detector (skip vs. fail).
61|    - c. Fail-fast proof: stage a deliberately text-corrupted PNG copy in `/tmp` or `scratch/` (never committed), run the guard, observe non-zero exit + filename + remedy; then run the recipe capture and observe valid magic.
62|    - d. Agent walkthrough: a fresh agent follows only the documented recipe to attach a proof PNG to a scratch task folder — no text-tool step, detector green. Record the exact commands run.
63|    - e. Gate placement check: confirm which automated gate invokes the guard (pre-commit and/or `npm test` branch) and show one run where the corruption fails there instead of after a full CI cycle.
64|11. Documentation plan: `GitGuidance.md` delta + new near-folder note (both locations cross-link the recipe, neither duplicates the detector's job); stage report quotes the `xxd`/`file` outputs for each touched proof; this plan file stays as the audit trail. No changes to `README.md` (owner-maintained) or to b1c069e0's detector semantics.
65|12. Rollout: land guard + docs + repairs as one reviewable unit; if the guard mechanism choice from Phase 1 proves harness-dependent, land docs + recipe + repair first and the guard second rather than blocking prevention docs on tooling.
66|
67|## Risks and Open Questions
68|
69|- **Guard mechanism uncertainty (highest risk):** if neither a pre-commit hook nor a preflight script can intercept the actual agent text-tool write path, the guard degrades to "detect earlier" rather than "impossible". Mitigation: the Phase 0 spike must demonstrate a real interception (or rejection) on a fixture before Phase 2 is built; otherwise scope the ticket to fail-fast-at-commit plus docs and record tool-level blocking as a follow-on.
70|- **Scope creep into tagging infra:** the survey notes ask for expandable taggable-file support. This plan makes the extension list data-driven but does not build tagging UI — that is a separate ticket.
71|- **Repair without a good source:** if any corrupt PNG has no valid git ref, it is baselined per the existing convention, not reconstructed or AI-regenerated (a regenerated image would be a fabrication, not a restoration).
72|- **None (checked):** no open Stage-1 ticket covers this (per ticket notes); `agents.md`/`AGENTS-MAP.md` need only pointer-level updates if the new note changes navigation.
73|
74|## Non-Goals
75|
76|- No changes to `scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs` pass/fail semantics (b1c069e0 stays as is).
77|- No new capture engine; no `README.md` edits; no source, config, or test changes beyond the guard + its tests + the two doc locations.
78|- No long-lived servers for verification; no bulk reformatting or unrelated hygiene.

body = {
  "projectId": "0fd41821-d8a5-4e49-bc2e-28ce8c739a0a",
  "title": "Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder",
  "goal": (
    "# Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder\n\n"
    "## Problem\n"
    "The repo's screenshot tool (`scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs`) writes PNG bytes directly, which is the "
    "binary-safe way for agents to attach proof screenshots. But its `--out` flag defaults to `screenshot.png` "
    "in the repo root (code: `getArg(\"--out\") || \"screenshot.png\"`). Every agent must therefore remember to "
    "pass an explicit `--out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png` on every capture. If an agent forgets or "
    "improvises, the PNG lands at the repo root, trips the repo-root scratch-hygiene gate, and costs a full "
    "verification cycle to diagnose and move — the same class of wasted cycle the proof-hygiene work was "
    "created to eliminate. The safe recipe in `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md` works only when the one easy-to-forget "
    "flag is present.\n\n"
    "## Fix\n"
    "Make the capture script default to a task-folder-aware output path so the no-flag invocation is already "
    "correct: when `--out` is omitted, resolve the current task id (in order: an explicit env var such as "
    "`TASK_ID`/`KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` if the runner sets one, else the `kb/<task-id>` git branch name, else fail with "
    "a message naming the expected `--out` form) and write to `docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png`, "
    "creating the directory as today. Keep an explicit `--out` as an override that always wins. Update the header "
    "usage comment, the `_PROOF_RULE.md` recipe, and `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` if they show the default. "
    "Add unit tests mirroring the existing `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` style: default resolves into the "
    "task folder when the id is discoverable; explicit `--out` wins; no discoverable id fails fast naming `--out`.\n\n"
    "## Acceptance criteria\n"
    "- [ ] Running the capture script without `--out` on a task branch writes a valid PNG (magic `89504e47`) under `docs/tasks/<task-id>/`, never repo root.\n"
    "- [ ] An explicit `--out` still overrides the default exactly as today.\n"
    "- [ ] With no discoverable task id, the script exits non-zero with a message showing the `--out` form.\n"
    "- [ ] `npm run check:proof-hygiene`, `npm run check:binaries`, and the existing capture/guard test suites stay green.\n\n"
    "## Non-goals\n"
    "No change to the PNG byte-writing mechanism, the binary guard, or the proof-hygiene detector semantics; no new runtime dependencies.\n\n"
    "## Case study\n"
    "Follow-on from KainBain task ef569a1a-d301-4e10-aaba-8cde942b97e8 (\"Prevent binary proof PNG corruption "

The repo's screenshot tool (`scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs`) writes PNG bytes directly, which is the binary-safe way for agents to attach proof screenshots.
